verdict.rationale: Ramp has in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting users plug external MCP servers into them is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Ramp acting as an MCP server (Ramp MCP, Developer MCP, Ramp Data MCP) that outside assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to. Nothing shows Ramp's own agents connecting to or consuming tools from third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
